senses.gloss: प्रद प्र-द, &c. See प्र-दा, p. 630, col. 1.

प्र-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving away, giving, a giver,
bestower, yielding, presenting, granting, bestowing,
[]
conferring (generally at the end of a comp.; cf.
बहु-प्˚, प्राण-प्˚, रुचि-प्˚, शाप-प्˚, सस्य-प्˚);
liberal, bountiful; (आ), f. a gift.

प्रदा प्र-दा (see rt. 1. दा), cl. 3. P. (rarely
in the earlier language A.) -ददाति (-दत्ते), -दातुम्,
to give away, give to, give; to give up, deliver; to
offer, present, grant; to give a daughter in marriage;
to sell (with inst. of the price); to restore; to put in,
place in; (with ऋणम्) to pay, discharge a debt;
(with विद्याम्) to communicate or impart know-
ledge; (with प्रतिवचः) to give an answer; (with
युद्धम्) to give battle; (with द्वन्द्व-युद्-
धम्) to engage in single combat; (with प्र-
वृत्तिम्) to give information of an event; (with
हुताशनम्) to set fire to: Pass. -दीयते, to be
given away, to be given: Caus. -दापयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to give, compel to give back or to repay; to
cause to put or place in: Desid. -दित्सते, to wish to
give in marriage.

प्रादा प्रा-दा (प्र-आ-), cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति,
-दत्ते, -दातुम्, to give, bestow.

प्रदक्षिण प्र-दक्षिण, अस्, आ, अम्, moving
to the right, standing or placed on the right; auspi-
cious, favourable, of good omen; respectful, reve-
rential; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. turning the right side
towards (any one), reverential salutation by circum-
ambulation from left to right so that the right side
is towards the person saluted; (अम्), ind. from left
to right, towards the right side, so that the right
side is turned towards a person or object (as a sign
of respect, e. g. पूज्यः प्रदक्षिणम्, to be
honoured by keeping the right side towards him);
[]
प्रदक्षिणं कृ or प्र-कृ, to pass on the right,
turn the right side towards (in token of respect);
towards the south, in a southern direction [from the
east, Manu III. 87]; (एण), ind. from left to right;
towards the south; अ-प्रदक्षिणम्, ‘not towards
the right,’ towards the left.
—प्रदक्षिण-क्रिया,
f. turning the right side towards (any one), showing
respect.
—प्रदक्षिण-पट्टिका, f. a yard, a
court-yard.
—प्रदक्षिण-प्रक्रमण, अम्, n.
proceeding with the right side towards (anything).
—प्रदक्षिणार्चिस् (˚ण-अर्˚), इस्, इस्, इस्, having
flames turned towards the right, flaming towards the
right.
—प्रदक्षिणावर्त (˚ण-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
turned towards the right.
—प्रदक्षिणावृत्क
(˚ण-आव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, turned towards the right,
having (any one or anything) on the right.
—प्र-
दक्षिणी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, to turn
the right side towards (with acc.); to go round from
left to right.
—प्रदक्षिणी-कृत्य, ind. having
gone round from left to right.

प्रदक्षिणय, Nom. P. प्रदक्षिणयति,
यितुम्, to go round from left to right.
प्रदक्षिणित्, ind., Ved. = प्र-दक्षिणम्, q. v.
प्रदग्ध प्र-दग्ध, &c. See प्र-दह् below.

प्र-दग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, consumed, de-
stroyed.
प्रदत्त प्र-दत्त, &c. See col. 2.

प्रदम् प्र-दम्, Caus. P. A. -दमयति, -ते,
-यितुम्, to subdue, conquer, overpower.

प्र-दाम्, -दान्, m. one who tames or subdues;
[cf. Pāṇ. VIII. 2, 64.]
प्र-दान्त, आस्, m. pl., N. of a school.
प्रदान्त प्र-दान्त, &c. See प्र-दम्, col. 1.
प्रदर प्र-दर. See प्र-दॄ, p. 631, col. 1.

प्र-दर, अस्, m. splitting, rending, tearing; a
fracture, breach, crack, crevice, cleft in the earth; the
dispersion of an army; a particular disease of women,
mænorrhagia; an arrow; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

प्रदर्प प्र-दर्प, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 3. दृप् with
प्र), pride, arrogance.
प्र-दृपित in अ-प्˚, q. v.
प्र-दृप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, proud, haughty, conceited.

प्र-दृप्ति, इस्, f. haughtiness, arrogance, madness;
(Sāy. = अनर्थ-हेतुः प्रदर्पः.)
प्रदृप्ति प्र-दृप्ति. See प्र-दर्प, p. 630.
प्रदर्श प्र-दर्श, &c. See प्र-दृश्, p. 631.

प्र-दर्श, अस्, m. looking, look, appearance;
direction, injunction.

प्रदल प्र-दल, अस्, m. an arrow (= प्र-
दर).

प्रदव प्र-दव, प्र-दव्य, प्र-दाव्य. See
प्र-दु, col. 3, and p. 631, col. 1.
प्र-दव, अस्, आ, अम्, burning, inflaming.

प्रदस् प्र-दस्, cl. 4. P. -दस्यति, -दसितुम्,
to dry up, become dry.

प्रदह् प्र-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्,
to burn, consume, destroy: Pass. -दह्यते, to take
fire, be consumed by fire, be burnt, burn.
प्र-दग्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be burnt.
प्र-दाह, अस्, m., Ved. burning, destroying by fire.
प्र-ददि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. liberal, bountiful.

प्र-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who gives or bestows,
giving, liberal; a giver, donor; one who gives a
daughter away in marriage; ‘the giver,’ an epithet
of Indra; N. of a divinity enumerated among the
Viśve Devāḥ.

1. प्र-दान, अम्, n. (for 2. प्र-दान see below),
giving, offering, presenting, bestowing, granting [cf.
पाणि-प्˚, वर-प्˚]; an oblation (especially one made
by fire); the words or sacred texts recited during
an oblation by fire (for प्रदान-मन्त्र); impart-
ing, communicating, teaching [cf. वेद-प्˚, and see
Manu II. 171]; giving away in marriage; applying
(a clyster); a gift, present.
—प्रदान-कृपण,
अस्, आ, अम्, mean or niggardly in making presents.
—प्रदान-पूर्वम्, ind. with a present.
—प्र-
दान-रुचि, इस्, f. ‘delighting in giving,’ N. of a
man.
—प्रदान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, giving, liberal.
—प्रदान-शूर, अस्, m., lit. a hero in giving,
i. e. an excessively liberal man [cf. दान-शूर,
दान-वीर]; N. of a Bodhi-sattva.

प्रदान 2. प्र-दान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 3. दा
with प्र), a goad. (For. 1. प्र-दान see above.)
प्रदानक, अम्, n. an offering, oblation.

प्रदानिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
relating to giving or offering; [cf. दत्ताप्˚.]

प्र-दापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who causes to
give; (Ved.) one who gives, a giver.

प्र-दाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to give, to
be compelled to pay.
प्र-दाय, अम्, n. a present.
प्रादाय, ind. having given or bestowed.

प्र-दायक, अस्, इका, अम्, giving, granting, pre-
senting, bestowing.
—प्रदायक-त्व, अम्, n. the
being a giver, giving.

प्र-दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, giving away, giving, a giver,
granting, presenting.
—प्रदायि-त्व, अम्, n. the
being a giver, giving.

प्र-दि, इस्, m. a gift, present (Schol. on Pāṇ. III.
3, 92).

प्र-दित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to
give (with acc.).

प्र-देय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given or granted, to
be offered or awarded to (in these senses sometimes
compounded with a word denoting the recipient,
cf. राज-प्˚, शिष्य-प्˚); to be imparted, to be taught
or instructed; to be given in marriage, marriageable;
(अस्), m. a present.
प्रदिग्ध प्र-दिग्ध. See प्र-दिह्, col. 3.

प्र-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, smeared over, besmeared,
daubed, bedaubed, anointed, overspread; (अम्), n.,
scil. मांस, a kind of dish prepared with meat;
(अस्), m. a kind of sauce or gravy.

प्रदिव् प्र-दिव्, -द्यौस्, f., Ved. the third
or highest heaven (in which the Pitṛs are said to
dwell); the fifth of the seven heavens; (according to
Sāy.) = पुराण, existing from olden times, ancient;
प्र-दिवस्, ind. from the remotest or earliest times,
from of old, long since, always, constantly, ever; अनु
प्रदिवः, as of old, as formerly; (प्र-दिवि), ind.
at all times, always, constantly, ever.

प्रदिश् 1. प्र-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्,
to point out, show; to signify, announce, declare,
communicate, make known; to direct; to appoint,
ordain, prescribe, instruct; to urge on, incite; to
assign; cl. 4. P. -दिश्यति, &c., to grant: Caus.
-देशयति, -यितुम्, to urge on, incite: Intens.
-देदेष्टि, to animate (Ved.).

2. प्र-दिश्, क्, f. pointing to, pointing out; direc-
tion, order, command, instruction; a direction, quarter,
region of the sky (of which from four to seven are
enumerated in the Veda; पित्र्या प्रदिश्, the region
of the Pitṛs, i. e. the south; प्रदिशो गतम्, gone
[]
towards all quarters of the heavens); an intermediate
point of the compass or half quarter, as north-east,
south-west, &c.

प्र-दिश्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being pointed out,
being urged on or incited.

प्र-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pointed out, announced,
declared; directed, ordained, appointed.

प्र-देश, अस्, m. pointing out, showing; direc-
tion, decision, determination; appealing to a pre-
cedent; an example (in grammar &c.); a place,
(प्रदेशेषु, in various places), spot, region; a
country, district, foreign country; a wall; a short
span measured from the tip of the thumb to that of
the forefinger.
—प्रदेश-कारिन्, ई, m. epithet of a
kind of ascetic.
—प्रदेश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possess-
ing or occupying a place.
—प्रदेश-शास्त्र, अम्, n. a
book containing examples (in grammar).
—प्रदेश-
स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being or situated in a district.
प्रदेश प्र-देश. See p. 630, col. 3.

प्रादेश प्रादेश, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-देश), the
span of the thumb and forefinger, the space measured
by the span of the thumb and forefinger; place,
country (?).
—प्रादेश-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, only a
span long; प्रादेशमात्रम् भूमेः, a mere span
of land.

प्र-देशन, अम्, n. a gift, present, bribe; an
offering, anything given to the gods, to superiors,
or friends; (ई), f. the index finger, forefinger; the
corresponding toe.
प्रादेशन, अम्, n. = प्र-देशन, a gift, &c.
प्र-देशित, अस्, आ, अम्, urged, directed.

प्र-देशिनी, f. the index finger, forefinger; the
corresponding toe.

प्र-देष्टृ, टा, m. one who pronounces judg-
ment, a judge.

प्रदिह् प्र-दिह्, cl. 2. P. -देग्धि, -देग्धुम्,
to smear over, besmear, smear, daub, anoint.

प्र-देह, अस्, m. a plaster, a thick or viscid
ointment; applying a plaster, unction; solid food
(perhaps inspissated juice and the like).
प्रदीदी प्र-दीदी = प्र-दीधी below.

प्रदीधी प्र-दीधी (see rt. 1. दीधी), cl. 2. A.
-दीधीते, &c., Ved. to shine forth, shine brilliantly.

प्र-दीध्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. shining forth,
shining brilliantly.

प्रदीप् प्र-दीप्, cl. 4. A. -दीप्यते, -दीपितुम्,
to flame forth, blaze, burst into flames: Caus. -दीप-
यति, -यितुम्, to set on fire, set fire to, light, kindle,
inflame.

प्र-दीप, अस्, m. a light, a lamp, lantern; that
which illuminates or illustrates, an enlightener; (often
at the end of a comp., e. g. कुल-प्˚, ‘the light of
a family;’ especially in titles of explanatory works,
cf. महाभाष्य-प्˚.)
—प्रदीप-मञ्जरी, f., N.
of a commentary by Rāmeśvara on the Amara-
koṣa.
—प्रदीप-शरण-ध्वज, अस्, m., N. of
a Mahoraga-rāja.
—प्रदीप-साह, अस्, m. (साह
= شاه), N. of a prince.

प्रदीपक, अस्, इका, m. f. a small lamp, a lamp;
(अस्, इका, अम्), illuminating, illustrating, clearing up.

प्र-दीपन, अस्, ई, अम्, inflaming, illuminating;
stimulating, exciting; (अम्), n. the act of kindling,
inflaming, igniting, exciting, &c.; (अस्), m. a sort of
mineral poison (of a red colour and caustic in its action).

प्रदीपाय, Nom. A. प्रदीपायते, -यितुम्, to re-
present a lamp, to act as a lamp, act the part of a lamp.

प्रदीपीय or प्रदीप्य. See Gaṇa to Pāṇ. V.
1, 4.

प्र-दीप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, kindled, inflamed, lighted
up, illuminated; blazing, burning, shining; excited,
stimulated; clear, shrill (opposed to पूर्ण, as a
term of augury?).

प्र-दीप्ति, इस्, f. light, lustre, splendor, brilliancy.
—प्रदीप्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, bright, radiant, lu-
minous.

प्रदीर्घ प्र-दीर्घ, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly
long.

प्रदु प्र-दु, cl. 4. A. -दूयते, -दोतुम्, to
be consumed by fire; cl. 5. P. -दुनोति, &c., to
distress, pain, torment, torture; to press hard.

प्र-दव्य or प्र-दाव्य, अस्, m., Ved., scil.
अग्नि, a forest fire (= दावाग्नि).

प्रदुष् प्र-दुष्, cl. 4. P. -दुष्यति, -दोष्टुम्,
to become worse, deteriorate; to be defiled or pol-
luted; to do amiss, act improperly, fall (morally);
to commit an offence against (with acc.): Caus.
-दूषयति, -यितुम्, to spoil, deprave, corrupt; to
defile, pollute, contaminate, vitiate, damage; to speak
ill of, abuse, blame, censure.

प्रादुस् प्रादुस्, ind. (perhaps fr. प्रा for
1. प्र + 1. दुर्, i. e. before or outside the door, in
open daylight; said to be fr. rt. अद् with प्र; accord-
ing to Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 41, the final स् is changed into ष्
before क् and प्; and according to Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 87, the
radical स् of rt. 1. अस्, ‘to be,’ is changed to ष् after
प्रादुस् whenever in the conjugation of this rt. the
initial अ is dropped, e. g. प्रादुः षन्ति, not प्रा-
दुः सन्ति; प्रादुस् appears to occur only in con-
nection with the rts. 1. अस्, 1. भू, and 1. कृ, except
in the comp. प्रादुष्-पीतम् given as an example
by the Scholiast on Pāṇ. VIII. 3, 41); apparently,
evidently, manifestly, visibly, in sight. According
to native lexicographers the senses in which प्रादुस्
is used may be expressed by the following Sanskrit
words, प्राकाश्य, नामन्, सम्-भाव्य, सम्-भव,
प्र-वृत्ति, वृत्ति.

प्र-दुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, corrupt, wicked, bad,
wrong, sinful; licentious, wanton, infamous.

प्र-दूषण, अस्, ई, अम्, corrupting, spoiling;
defiling, contaminating.

प्र-दूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, corrupted, spoilt; de-
praved, vitiated; defiled, polluted.

प्र-दोष, अस्, आ, अम्, corrupt, bad, wicked;
(अस्), m. defect, fault, offence, sin, transgression,
guilt; a disordered condition (of the body or of the
state), mutiny, insurrection, rebellion; the first part
of the night, evening twilight, evening, nightfall;
Evening personified (and associated with Niśitha and
Vyuṣṭa as a son of Doṣā); (अम्), ind., Ved. in
the evening, in the dark.
—प्रदोष-काल, अस्, m.
evening tide.
—प्रदोष-तिमिर, अम्, n. evening
darkness, the dusk of early night.
—प्रदोष-पूजा-
विधि, इस्, m. and प्रदोष-शिव-पूजा, f., N. of
two works.
—प्रदोष-रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, plea-
sant or delightful in the evenings.
—प्रदोषागम
(˚ष-आग्˚), अस्, m. the coming on of evening, nightfall.
प्रदोष प्र-दोष. See col. 1.

प्रादोष प्रादोष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-दोष),
belonging or relating to the evening, vespertine.

प्रदोषक, अस्, आ, अम्, born in the evening;
(according to a Scholiast) a proper N.

प्रदुह् 1. प्र-दुह्, cl. 2. P. A. -दोग्धि, -दुग्-
धे, -दोग्धुम्, to milk; to yield milk or any
desired object.
2. प्र-दुह्, -धुक्, क्, क्, milking, milking well.
प्र-दोह, अस्, m. milking.
प्र-दोहन, अस्, m., N. of a man.

प्रदृश् प्र-दृश्, cl. 1. P. -पश्यति, -द्रष्-
टुम्, to look forward, see in front, foresee; to see,
behold, view; to perceive, observe, discern, distin-
guish, learn; to look at, look upon; to regard,
judge; to have a view or opinion; to be intelligent:
Pass. -दृश्यते, to become visible, to be seen or
observed; to look, appear: Caus. -दर्शयति, -यि-
तुम्, to foreshow, show forth, bring to light, make
visible, display, exhibit; to describe; to make clear,
explain, teach: Desid. -दिदृक्षति, to wish to see.

प्र-दर्शक, अस्, इका, अम्, foreshowing, fore-
telling, presaging; a prophet; showing, exhibiting,
displaying; presenting; proclaiming, announcing;
propounding, teaching, instructing; a teacher, in-
structor, expounder; a doctrine, principle.

प्र-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, foreshown, prophesied;
shown forth, shown, brought to light, manifested,
exhibited, evinced; made known, signified; rendered
clear, taught; mentioned, declared, specified.

प्र-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing, viewing; pointing
out, showing, indicating.
प्र-दर्श्य, ind. having exhibited or shown.

प्रदॄ प्र-दॄ, cl. 9. P. -दृणाति, -दरितुम्,
-दरीतुम्, to break or tear to pieces (Ved.): Pass.
-दीर्यते, to cleave asunder, split open (intrans.);
to be dispersed or scattered: Caus. -दारयति, -यि-
तुम्, to split, cleave, tear asunder.

प्रद्यु प्र-द्यु, उ, n. (fr. प्र + 3. द्यु or 3.
दिव्), good works leading to heaven, works securing
heaven.

प्रद्युत् प्र-द्युत्, cl. 1. A. -द्योतते, -द्योति-
तुम्, to begin to shine or to be brilliant: Caus. -द्यो-
तयति, -यितुम्, to irradiate, illumine.

प्र-द्युतित, अस्, आ, अम्, beginning to shine or
to be brilliant; illuminated, irradiated, lighted.

प्र-द्योत, अस्, m. illumining, irradiating; splen-
dor, lustre, light; a ray of light; N. of a Yakṣa;
of a king of Magadha and founder of a dynasty; of
a king of Ujjayinī.

प्र-द्योतन, अस्, m. the sun; N. of a prince of
Ujjayinī; (अम्), n. blazing, shining, light.
प्र-द्योतित, अस्, आ, अम्, = प्र-द्युतित.
प्र-द्योतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, illumining, irradiating.

प्रद्युम्न प्र-द्युम्न, अस्, m. (fr. प्र +
द्युम्न, see p. 438, col. 1), ‘the pre-eminently
mighty one,’ an epithet of Kāma-deva the god of
love, or of that deity in another birth (regarded as a
son of Kṛṣṇa and Rukmiṇī, or as a son of Saṅkar-
ṣaṇa and then identified with Sanat-kumāra); N. of
a son of Manu and Naḍvalā; of an astronomer; of
a mountain (?); of a river.
—प्रद्युम्न-पुर,
अम्, n. ‘Pradyumna's city,’ N. of a town on the
Candra-bhāgā or Chenab.
—प्रद्युम्न-विजय, अस्,
m. ‘Pradyumna's victory (over Vajra-nābha),’ N. of a
drama by Śaṅkara-dīkṣita.
—प्रद्युम्नागमन
(˚न-आग्˚), अम्, n. the arrival of Pradyumna.
—प्र-
द्युम्नागमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, treating of the
arrival of Pradyumna.
प्रद्रव प्र-द्रव, प्र-द्राव. See below.
प्र-द्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, fluid, liquid.

प्र-द्राव, अस्, m. running away, running, flight,
retreat, escape; going, going quickly or well.

प्रद्राणक प्र-द्राणक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2.
द्रा with प्र), sorely distressed, very needy or
indigent, very poor.

प्रद्रु प्र-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्,
to run forwards, run away, flee, escape, escape to
(with acc.); to hasten, hasten away, go away; to
hasten towards, rush against; to fall upon, assail;
to attain: Caus. -द्रावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
run away, put to flight, rout.

प्राद्रु प्रा-द्रु (प्र-आ-द्रु), cl. 1. P. -द्र-
वति, -द्रोतुम्, to run away from, flee from; to
escape to, escape.

प्र-द्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, runaway, fugitive; one who
retreats or flies, retreating, flying, going.

प्रद्रुह् प्र-द्रुह्, -ध्रुक्, क्, क्, one who
hurts or injures, trying to hurt.

प्रद्रेक् प्र-द्रेक्, cl. 1. A. -द्रेकते, -द्रेकि-
तुम्, to shout out; to neigh, to roar, bellow.

प्रद्वार् प्र-द्वार्, f. or प्र-द्वार, अम्, n. a
place before a door or gate.

प्रद्विष् 1. प्र-द्विष्, cl. 2. P. A. -द्वेष्टि,
-द्विष्टे, -द्वेष्टुम्, to feel dislike or repugnance
for, dislike, hate; to show one's hatred.

2. प्र-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, feeling dislike or repugnance
for, disliking, hating.

प्र-द्विषत्, अन्, अती, अत्, feeling dislike or re-
pugnance for, hating, hostile, an enemy.

प्र-द्वेष, अस्, m. dislike, repugnance, aversion,
disinclination, hatred, hostility; (ई), f., N. of the
wife of Dīrgha-tamas.
प्र-द्वेषण, अम्, n. hating, hatred, hostility.

प्र-द्वेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who dislikes or
hates, a disliker, hater.

प्राद् प्राद् (प्र-अद्), cl. 2. P. प्रात्ति, प्रात्-
तुम्, to eat up, consume, devour.

प्रादक्षिण्य प्रादक्षिण्य, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-
दक्षिण), keeping the right side towards anything
while moving round it, circumambulation by starting
from the left and coming round to the right (by
way of reverence).

प्रादित्य प्रादित्य (प्र-आद्˚), अस्, m., N. of
two princes.

प्रादुराक्षि प्रादुराक्षि, इस्, m. a patronymic;
(perhaps an incorrect form for प्रादुर्-अक्षि.)

प्रादुर्-अस् (see rt. 1. अस्), cl. 2. P. अस्ति, &c., to
be apparent or evident, to be manifest; to appear,
arise, exist.

प्रादुर्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to
become manifest, become visible; to appear, arise,
come to light, exist; to become audible, be heard.
—प्रादुर्-भाव, अस्, m. the becoming manifest or
visible, arising, coming into existence, appearance,
manifestation; the appearance of a deity on earth;
the being evident; the becoming audible.
—प्रादुर्-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become manifest or evident, come
to light, manifested, appeared, revealed.

प्रादुष्-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to make visible or manifest, bring to light, reveal,
disclose, exhibit, manifest.
—प्रादुष्-करण, अम्,
n. the making visible, bringing to light, manifesta-
[]
tion, production.
—प्रादुष्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made
visible, brought to light, manifested, displayed to
view.
—प्रादुष्कृत-वपुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, one whose
form is manifested, appearing in a visible form (as a
deity).
—प्रादुष्-कृत्य, ind. having brought to
light, having produced.
प्रादुष्य, अम्, n. appearance, manifestation.

प्रादेशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-देश), authorized
by precedents or examples, precedented; significant,
indicatory of the original meaning; local, limited,
relating to a part; प्रादेशिको गुणः, the property
of a word indicatory of its original or etymological
meaning; (अस्), m. a small landed proprietor, the
owner or chief of a district.
—प्रादेशिकेश्वर (˚क-
ईश्˚), अस्, m. the owner or chief of a district, a small
landed proprietor, (opposed to सार्वभौम.)
प्रादोषिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = प्रादोष.

प्रादोहनि प्रादोहनि, इस्, m. a patronymic
from Pra-dohana.

प्राद्युम्नि प्राद्युम्नि, इस्, m. a patronymic
from Pra-dyumna.

प्राद्योति प्राद्योति, इस्, m. a patronymic
from Pra-dyota.
